book.name: iMaki
book.title: Esɔ Osuse mi abɔ mgbi iMaki

content: IYesu kyile inggisɛ ngbikye tukwu esɛ
Ngwi egbe wa sisi gwee nɛ, iYesu si yidɔ lu iKapenahun, inggisɛ ntona si fwo gbɛɛ o yɛ kaka udɛ.
Ta inggisɛ kwuba kwakye mbonyi, nghanɛ imbe dzɛma wuba, onufɛ mi esɛ kpaa imbe dzɛ ba. IYesu sile gbeesɔ nya ma.
Ta inggisɛ angbeka nghi enɛ wa to, kye inggisɛ ngbikye tukwu esɛ le ba mbi iYesu.
Dafi a yagba kyon kaka mbi iYesu ba ikye ibyi inggisɛ nɛ, a ka flɛ ikpendu mi ikye mgbi iYesu yɛyɛ man kyon tashulu yi amukwu wa lakiyayi iYesu.
Ngwi iYesu di oyɛyɛ onuunu mgbi ama nɛ, o nya inggisɛ ngbikye tukwu esɛ na gbɛɛ, <<Ongwɛ, a dzita abu yi ali ibwubwe mgbi abu.>>
Etsetse mgbi ola mgbi iMose angbeka sɔto mmanani, a le tsɛwɛ mi itukwu mgbi ama gbɛɛ,
<<Kyɔsinɛse inggisɛ nɛ gbɔdzɛ ngha? O le kwu Imgbasho shanyɛ! Li emɛ ka dzɛ inggisɛ ta yi obube se Imgbasho yuon ta baa?>>
Plɛ nɛta, iYesu ka ye mi onodzi mgban gbɛɛ li ungwɔ ngwi a le tsɛwɛ mi itukwu mgbi ama joaali, man o nya ma gbɛɛ, <<I kyɔsinɛ ngwi ema le tsɛwɛ itɔ ungwɔ ntonɛ?
Li ole nghao sunɔ ba: onya inggisɛ ngbikye tukwu esɛ na gbɛɛ, <A dzɛ abu ta yi ali ibwubwe,> naadi o gbɛɛ, <Kyato, kyelu obutu mgbi abu kyikyɛ>?
Nghaduu li onu ema ye gbɛɛ Ongwɛ Inggisɛ dzɛ yi mfye mi ɛsɛ nɛ odzɛ inggisɛ ta yi ali ibwubwe…>> O nya inggisɛ ogbikye tukwu esɛ na gbɛɛ,
<<N nya abu, kyato, kyelu obutu mgbi abu lu udɛ.>>
O kyato, kyelu obutu mgban si kyikyɛ mi inai ma duu. Ungwɔnɛ kwulu ali inggisɛ duu ewo man a si tsɛ Imgbasho, le gbɛɛ, <<Eyi yama di itɔ ungwɔnɛ ye ba!>>
IYesu kwu iLevi ela
Nɛ iYesu di yidɔ kɛ ondu utɔ mgbi iGalalia. Ibyi inggisɛ ba mbon, ta o si wita otso ma.
Dafi o kyikyɛ le kɛ nɛ, o di inggisɛ ogbɛ udza ifyɛɛ, iLevi ongwɛ Alfeɔ sɔdzɛ opo ogbɛ udza ifyɛɛ. Man iYesu nyan gbɛɛ, <<Kyɛdɔ ani,>> ta iLevi kyato kyɛdɔn.
Dafi iYesu le gye ungwogye ongwi onɔdɛ mi udɛ iLevi nɛ, ama ogbɛ udza ifyɛɛ kwuba yi <<emi ali ibwubwe angbeka>> tole gye ungwogye biyan bɛyi engwafɔɔn, lubana inggisɛ kwuba kyɛdɔn.

Ngwi etsetse mgbi ola mgbi iMose ama nli emi iFarasi din le gye ungwogye yi <<emi ali ibwubwe>> yi ama ogbɛ udza ifyɛɛ nɛ, a byi engwafɔɔn gbɛɛ: <<Kyɔsinɛ ngwi ongyukwo mgbi ema le gye ungwogye yi ama ogbɛ udza ifyɛɛ yi <emi ali ibwubwe>? >>
Ngwi IYesu fwo ungwɔnɛ nɛ, o nya ma gbɛɛ, <<Li ama nle saan ma li mina inggisɛ obwe ootse ba, kpaa li emi ootse. Ani ba owa kwu ama nle saan ela ba, kpaa li emi ali ibwubwe.>>
A byi iYesu ita mi odzɛ onduotukwu-tukwu

Onɔ oka nɛ ama okyɛ yi iJɔn okyɔ iBatisima bɛyi emi iFarasi tole tukwondu. Inggisɛ angbeka si ba wa byi iYesu gbɛɛ, <<Kyɔsinɛse ngwi engwafɔ mgbi iJɔn okyɔ iBatisima bɛyi engwafɔ mgbi emi iFarasi tole tukwondu, kpaa engwafɔ mgbi abu le tukwondu ba?>>
IYesu nya ma gbɛɛ, <<Ingyoga emi oga mgbi eba ka tukwondu onɔ ngwi obongyaa dzɛ yi ama maa? Ungwɔ ka dzɛ ngha ba du. Ngwi a ka dzɛ yi obongyaa tayɔ, a ka yama tukwondu ba.
Nghaduu onɔ kyɛma ngwi a ka kyi kyelu obongyaa mi idzidzɛ ma ta a ka tukwondu.
<<Inggisɛ onyi li kye ayɛ angwuto ofufɛ kye tukwu ogbugbe ba. Ki non kyɔ ngha, ayɛ ofufɛ na ka kyi kwolu di fawa angwuto ogbugbe nani, dika nu ifo na yɛɛ vɔn.

Inggisɛ onyi dika kye eneekwɔ ofufɛ yaokɛ ikpɔkpɔ eneekwɔ ogbugbe ba, ikyekyɛ eneekwɔ na ka nu ikpɔkpɔ gbobu, man eneekwɔ bɛyi ikpɔkpɔ duu ka nyanya. Kyɛmɛ yɔ a ka kye eneekwɔ ofufɛ yaokɛ ikpɔkpɔ ofufɛ.>>
Otsɛ mgbi egbe otonyewo mgbiemi iJuda
Egbe otonyidɔ mgbi emi iJuda oka nɛ, iYesu le kyikyɛ nyɛ okwɔ ungwogyowe, dafi engwafɔɔn wafɔ yan le kɛ nɛ, a wita ole ngwunu ungwogyowe.
Emi iFarasi gbɔ yan gbɛɛ, <<Dika, kyɔsinɛ ngwi a le kyungwɔ nli ola ba mi egbe otonyewo ngha?>>
IYesu si nya ma gbɛɛ, <<Ema gbɔ ungwɔ ngwi iDevedi yi emi ibugen nose kyɔ mi onɔ ngwi enbwa dɔ ma ngwi a di dzɛ mi imina na baa?

Mi onɔ ngwi Abiata nose li okwukwo inggisɛ ofifɛ mgbi Imgbasho mani, iDevedi kaka ozu mgbi Imgbasho ka gye ibredi ngwi a kye mse bɛ ele kye dzɛkɛ kyoon, ngwi ola gbɛɛ li ama ofifɛ mgbi Imgbasho ta ka gye mani. O di kye nu emi ibugen kpaa.>>
Nɛ iYesu nya ma gbɛɛ, <<A ta egbe otonyewo mi ikye inggisɛ, li inggisɛ ngwi a ta mi ikye egbe otonyewo ba.
Nghanɛ Ongwɛ Inggisɛ li Otsɛ mgbi egbe otonyewo kpaa.>>
